messages:
claire_docs: Hey all — PR #4829 (migration-guide: v1->v2 routing) is failing the docs CI preview. Getting markdownlint + spellcheck + vale errors. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4829

docs-bot: Automatic CI report: preview build 984 failed. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/984 — errors summarized below.

mike_infra: paste of errors from the log:
```
MD041: First line in file should be a top-level heading (migration/v1-to-v2.md:1)
linkcheck: broken link: https://old-service.example.com/auth -> 404 (migration/v1-to-v2.md:87)
vale: Use 'use' instead of 'utilize' (migration/v1-to-v2.md:45)
spellcheck: "envrionment" -> "environment" (migration/v1-to-v2.md:102)
```

raul_reviewer: I can take the vale/spell fixes. The link looks like it points to our deprecated internal host — should be /guides/auth-migration. Claire, did you mean to link externally?

claire_docs: Good catch — that link was copied from the old doc. Replace with /guides/auth-migration and add a relative link so linkcheck uses the preview site.

jen_preview: FYI merging window is 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight (staging deploy). If we fix today I can re-run preview and include in the nightly deploy; otherwise hold until tomorrow.

mike_infra: For MD041 we can just add a top-level H1 at the top: `# Migration: v1 → v2 routing` — I'll PR that tiny change if others OK.

raul_reviewer: Sounds good. I'll fix vale usages (search for 'utilize', 'leverage', and passive voice flagged). Also will correct the spelling typos.

claire_docs: thanks — assigning @raul_reviewer as reviewer on the PR. I pushed a small commit to swap the external link to the relative path and added the H1 in a follow-up commit.

docs-bot: CI re-run queued by claire_docs (preview build 985). Expect ~5–8 min.

jen_preview: if build passes ping me and I'll queue the staging merge during tonight's window. If it fails, we'll hold. :crossed_fingers:

raul_reviewer: Quick note — I noticed an API snippet uses inline HTML in a fenced block which trips markdownlint for code block language. I'll switch to fenced ```bash for commands and ```yaml for config. Small commit incoming.

claire_docs: great. Also added a short changelog note at the end per our docs style guide.

docs-bot: Preview build 985 completed — SUCCESS. All checks passed (markdownlint, linkcheck, vale, spellcheck).

jen_preview: Merging into staging now and scheduling the merge window for production if no regressions in staging smoke tests.

mike_infra: Thanks everyone. For posterity: checklist we followed so this is reproducible: 1) fix top-level heading, 2) replace absolute legacy links with relative site paths, 3) run vale locally (vale .) to catch style, 4) run markdownlint + linkcheck locally, 5) push and re-run preview.

claire_docs: I'll update the PR description with that checklist and add a note to our docs contributor guide. Closing thread when prod merge done. :white_check_mark:
